read.en: Rockwell Automation rose 2.0% on Nov 10 to $397.16, trading $388.40–397.53. It is below the 5-day ($397.5), 10-day ($420.5), 30-day ($430.0), 100-day ($442.6) and 200-day ($426.8); all five averages are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($446.19), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 11月10日上涨 2.0%，收于 $397.16，盘中区间 $388.40–397.53。股价位于 5 日（$397.5）、10 日（$420.5）、30 日（$430.0）、100 日（$442.6）和 200 日（$426.8）均线下方；五条均线均在下行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$446.19），RSI 为 40。

read.en: The close cleared the $392.5–396.3 resistance (Nov 6 and Nov 9 highs, Apr 29 low), now support, and finished at the day's high, just under the 5-day ($397.5). Resistance is $397.5, then $406.9–412.7 (Sep–Oct lows, Nov 5 high) and $420.5–430 (10, 200 and 30-day). Support is $388.4–396.3, then $383.1 and $375.7 (Feb 17 low). A close above $397.5 would target $407–413; below $388.4, $383.
